defect.repair: Compare child count, identity and order under the existing ownership token. Skip child replacement only when unchanged, still remove owned editor markers and release the claim. defect.boundedGuarantee: An unchanged host keeps connected children and current focus. This is not a promise to restore focus after a real partial mount changed the child tree.

developmentObservations.observation: The first browser checker mistakenly looked for the native code in Error.toString(). The local SDK exposes it separately as error.code. That assertion was corrected before the retained actual focus-loss reproduction.

The repaired local and document-local cases retained focus. The expanded shared case then exposed the checker's incorrect assumption that the shared boundary uses local structured error codes. It throws the native schema-admission string. Final checks require the exact local code or exact shared string; no arbitrary failure qualifies. The observer now retains asynchronously delivered child-mutation records instead of discarding them.
